narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.note: Tells the story of Israel in Egypt and the call of Moses.

pharaoh.name: Pharaoh
pharaoh.note: King of Egypt; calculating, haughty and harsh toward the Hebrews.

midwives.name: The Hebrew midwives
midwives.note: Sephora and Phua, answering the king; God-fearing, deferential but shrewd.

1.t: These are the names of the children of Israel, that went into Egypt with Jacob: they went in every man with his household:

4.t: Dan, and Nephthali, Gad and Aser.

5.t: And all the souls that came out of Jacob's thigh, were seventy: but Joseph was in Egypt.

6.t: After he was dead, and all his brethren, and all that generation,

7.t: The children of Israel increased, and sprung up into multitudes, and growing exceedingly strong they filled the land.

8.t: In the mean time there arose a new king over Egypt, that knew not Joseph:

9.t: And he said to his people:
Behold the people of the children of Israel are numerous and stronger than we.

10.t: Come let us wisely oppress them, lest they multiply: and if any war shall rise against us, join with our enemies, and having overcome us, depart out of the land.

11.t: Therefore he set over them masters of the works, to afflict them with burdens: and they built for Pharao cities of tabernacles, Phithom, and Ramesses.

12.t: But the more they oppressed them, the more they were multiplied and increased.

13.t: And the Egyptians hated the children of Israel, and afflicted them and mocked them:

14.t: And they made their life bitter with hard works in clay and brick, and with all manner of service, wherewith they were overcharged in the works of the earth.

15.t: And the king of Egypt spoke to the midwives of the Hebrews: of whom one was called Sephora, the other Phua,

16.t: When you shall do the office of midwives to the Hebrew women, and the time of delivery is come: if it be a man child, kill it: if a woman, keep it alive.

17.t: But the midwives feared God, and did not do as the king of Egypt had commanded, but saved the men children.

18.t: And the king called for them and said:
What is it that you meant to do, that you would save the men children?

19.t: The Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women: for they themselves are skilful in the office of a midwife; and they are delivered before we come to them.

20.t: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied and grew exceedingly strong.

21.t: And because the midwives feared God, he built them houses.

22.t: Pharao therefore charged all his people, saying:
Whatsoever shall be born of the male sex, ye shall cast into the river: whatsoever of the female, ye shall save alive.
